latest_version_code.description: The latest versionCode of the application (e.g. 1 corresponds to v1.0.0+1). Trigger update if > installed build number.

latest_version_name.description: User-facing version string displayed in the update dialog (e.g. 1.0.0).

min_supported_version_code.description: Minimum build number required to use the app. If installed build < this, force_update is enforced.

apk_download_url.description: Direct download link to the APK file hosted on Firebase Hosting, Storage, or website.

release_notes.description: Multiline bulleted notes or JSON array of strings describing what's new in this release.
